caption: The debugger prints fares as 92, 158 and 65 at indices 0, 1 and 2; the closed range 0...fares.count also asks for index 3, so the app stops there with Fatal error: Index out of range. The fix is 0..<fares.count, and because the app had already built and installed, this is a runtime crash, not a build error.

spec.title: fares = [92, 158, 65], count 3
spec.aria: One row named fares holds the values 92, 158 and 65 at indices 0, 1 and 2, all marked valid, and a fourth box at index 3 marked as the first bad index that the closed range 0...fares.count reaches, which stops the running app with an index out of range crash.
